note: The Civil Status Office communique of 24 June 2026 says the Rose Belle Civil Status Office moves on 29 June 2026 to Vieux Moulin Commercial Centre and will also run as a Single Point Office, where death registration, death certificates and burial or cremation permits are done under one roof by Civil Status Division, Public Health Office and local authority officers. It names no information system and says nothing on whether or how the record is made digitally.
